name: Senja Talalaeva
source:
A pretty six-year-old girl with a round face, large light blue[1] eyes, and long dark hair. It is mentioned that Senya has a scar on her left hand from a burn[1].

 In the photo, Senya is wearing a light-colored T-shirt and holding a white mug of tea. The missing person's announcement mentions that Senya was wearing a brown raincoat, a gray scarf, and mittens on the day she disappeared.
